title: Family Disapproval of a Relationship
summary: When family disapproves, it helps to understand their concerns, talk calmly, give time, and involve a trusted relative. Adults have the legal right to choose their partner, but safety matters if there are threats.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
